as_told.title: Wooden figurines seized at Lima airport conflated with the mummies

plain: In Peru, small three-fingered mummified figures known as the Nazca bodies are claimed by some to be non-human, and a podcast host, Jesse Michels, says one figure got mixed up with them. According to Michels, a local journalist named Manuel Caceres made knockoff merchandise copying the bodies, and such items, which he describes as wooden figurines, were seized at Lima Airport in 2023, while Flavio Estrada, speaking in an official role, is quoted saying "that one is fake," a built piece of craftsmanship. The point of the story is that a fake copy being confused with the originals would not, by itself, settle whether the originals are real.
